title: Closeout summary: Bundle TUI app into the release dist so bwrk dashboard works from the machine install
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Bundled apps/tui into the release dist (tools/build-cli-dist.mjs -> dist/tui/index.js, esbuild ESM with createRequire banner + react-devtools-core stub); spawnAppProcess prefers the bundled sibling app; release smoke in tests/runtime/cli-dist.test.ts boots the dashboard from a bare copied dist and asserts the rendered Roll-Up frame. Commit de8ac288 on branch tui/bundle-tui-dist.

Close reason: TUI ships in the dist artifact; bwrk dashboard launches from a standalone install; release smoke covers it
